policy: No external software, browser, SDK, Python package, model, or paid service is installed or tested by these scripts.

targetRuntime.basis: Installed @deepseek-ai/dsh package manifest; this does not certify compatibility of every bundle or another machine.

integrations.background-browser-control: Chrome plus chrome-devtools-mcp 1.9.0 ordinary dependency; configure Node executable, MCP entrypoint, Chrome executable, dedicated empty user-data directory and working directory independently.
integrations.playwright-extension-mcp: @playwright/mcp 0.0.83 ordinary dependency, Node, Chrome, dedicated user-data and work directory; browser extension/login is user-managed.
integrations.pinterest-browser-headless: Not included in the current release snapshot; the Playwright base patch is headed. Do not claim this overlay is available from this suite.
integrations.blender-mcp: Separate Python environment with blender_mcp.server, matching Blender add-on and Blender; configure exact Python executable and server repository cwd. No fixed workspace restore layout required.
integrations.windows-desktop-control: Windows and a separately installed windows-mcp Python environment; configure Python executable and cwd.
integrations.dev-shell-environment: Separately installed Git Bash executable configured explicitly; no UGit version-specific installation is required.
integrations.tool-call-compat: Version-sensitive Harness PTC executor module URL; configure exact target-compatible file:/// module URL. Installer may reject incompatible Harness versions; never grant an exception implicitly.
integrations.art-toolbox: sharp 0.35.5 ordinary dependency; optional ComfyUI root and backend with independently provisioned nodes/models. Windows process helpers require PowerShell. Optional Pinterest browser and production helpers require separate setup.
integrations.session-categories: sharp 0.35.5 ordinary dependency for thumbnails. Native optional packages must match destination platform. Lifecycle scripts remain disabled unless explicitly reviewed/approved.
integrations.supir-refine: Separate ComfyUI/SUPIR installation, configured Python executable and output directory; model weights are not bundled.
integrations.dsh-whale-widget: Web widget uses Harness; desktop pin optionally requires Windows x64, .NET 10 SDK/runtime and WebView2 runtime. scripts/build-whale.mjs --allow-restore explicitly downloads pinned NuGet WebView2 1.0.3537.50; this task did not run it. Native binaries and WebView2 DLLs are not redistributed.
integrations.workbuddy-experts: Optional independently installed WorkBuddy with user-owned expert catalogs. No credentials/cache/catalog data is redistributed.
integrations.drock-media: User supplies Drock service credentials through Harness settings. Generation is paid and was not tested.
integrations.google-chrome-control: User-managed everyday Chrome plus compatible connector/transport; explicit connection and user permissions remain required.

peerDependencyPolicy: Harness/React peers are supplied by compatible Harness; package-manager auto-install-peers must be disabled. zod/TypeScript needed by local plugins are ordinary dependencies. Use pnpm install --ignore-scripts --config.auto-install-peers=false only inside prepared plugin directories, never the profile.

licenseSources.betterSidebar: Preserved local source LICENSE; local version 0.28.2-local.1 and runtime source included.
